facts.title: Release effects
facts.text: World Class at release: +0.75s ball control, +1 dribble, +15% shot charge speed, +20% volley power, increased movement speed and no on-ball speed reduction.

history.title: Flow balance and fixes
history.text: Numerous flow buffs and nerfs. Magician Flow moved to Legendary; Emperor cooldown reduction changed from 33% to 20%. Infinite Awakening added to PS+.

history.title: NEL Nagi and Singularity
history.text: NEL Nagi World Class at release, with volley and ball-control passives. Singularity flow introduced and other styles adjusted.
